reigns.note: King of the Latins whom Ovid names son of Faunus — disambiguated as latinus-king from Odysseus' son Latinus in Apollodorus Epit. 7.24 and Hyginus' Telegonus strand.
Married Lavinia and succeeded to Latinus' kingdom after war with Turnus — the westward destiny Apollodorus Epit. 5.21 prepares when the Greeks spare him at Troy.
